modules.description: Modules of the `module_map` that got a dev agent. One agent per module, each in an isolated worktree.

400.description: No current `module_map` (the Architect has to define the modules first), or the project's stored workspace location is incoherent — the `permissions.json` seeded here cannot be derived from it (RN-478).

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Project, session, or task not found.

409.description: The origin session is `consultiva` and refuses `execution.activated` (RN-097). Activating twice is NOT a conflict: it is idempotent by `findActiveExecutionSession`, and reactivates inside the same session.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
